summary: Imports DirectX shared textures by handle for Windows DirectX interop workflows.
common_gotchas: A stale or invalid shared texture handle will not import useful image data.
Producer lifetime, texture format, and consumer timing matter for stable interop.
32-bit float input uses nearest filtering regardless of selected smoothing.
This operator is Windows/license gated and should not be planned for macOS projects.
key_concepts: DirectX In TOP imports shared DirectX textures from another application or DirectX Out TOP.
It uses DirectX Sharing Resources and supports DirectX 9.0 or later interop.
The Handle parameter identifies the shared texture resource to import.
A DirectX Out TOP Info DAT can provide handles for paired in/out workflows.
This is an interop endpoint, not a generic TOP selector.
The operator is Windows-only and available for Educational, Commercial, and Pro licenses.
